question: What was the cash prize awarded to the winner of the inaugural 2025 Dow Impact Award for innovation and sustainability in golf?
solution: The correct answer is __**$25,000**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The inaugural **2025 Dow Impact Award** was established to recognize excellence in **innovation and sustainability** within the golf industry. • The winner of this prestigious award is granted a cash prize of **$25,000** to further support and implement sustainable projects at their facility. • This award is a collaborative initiative between **Dow**, a global leader in materials science, and the **Golf Course Superintendents Association of America (GCSAA)**. • The primary objective of the **Dow Impact Award** is to celebrate **GCSAA members** who demonstrate leadership in environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and economic efficiency. • The first-ever recipient was announced during the **2025 GCSAA Conference and Trade Show** held in **San Diego, California**.
